BiblicalUsage: Meshol is a satire, a byword, the taunt a broken man becomes. Job 17:6 says, He hath made me also a byword of the people, and aforetime I was as a tabret.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a byword is the cruellest wound of all: not the loss, but being made into a saying for others to repeat.
